notes: v510 — the freezes while loading saved data are fixed, and the mystery of why NYSE loaded so slowly is solved — they were the same bug. When the app read your saved shares off this device, it walked through EVERY saved record of EVERY market: loading NYSE meant unpacking all four thousand ASX histories first just to throw them away, and the walk never paused to let the screen draw — measured at over sixteen seconds for NYSE with one dead freeze of more than two seconds. Now the app reads ONLY the market you asked for, in small pages, letting the screen breathe between pages. A subtle trap made this fix harder than it looks — the first attempt silently lost 94% of the market (the browser closes a database transaction the instant you pause inside it) — which is exactly why every change here is measured and verified before it reaches you: the test rig caught it, you never saw it. Loading either market should now feel steady, with no dead stalls. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
